cs2Loadouts.label: Project 1
cs2Loadouts.title: Streamer CS2 loadouts
cs2Loadouts.subtitle: Streamer loadouts plus CS2 skins, graffiti, stickers, and map legends — tap a slot to mark it collected.

p1BusterGoldAk.description: A full-gold AK from Buster’s on-stream flex loadout — the kind of skin chat spams «inspect» for.
p1BusterGoldAk.funFact: Gold Arabesque drops from Operation Riptide cases — one of the few AK finishes that looks like jewelry in inspect.

p1DonkKnife.description: donk’s butterfly doppler is basically a highlight reel accessory: flashy, loud, and always center stage.
p1DonkKnife.funFact: Butterfly knives have a unique flip animation — CS2 players call it free morale before the first duel.

p1S1mpleAwp.description: The Dragon Lore AWP linked with s1mple’s legacy — a trophy-skin energy even as a showcase piece.
p1S1mpleAwp.funFact: Dragon Lore is a Cobblestone collection skin; real souvenir versions can sell for more than a compact car.

p1ShroudM4.description: Shroud’s clean Printstream M4 fits his «headshot first, chat second» aesthetic on custom servers.
p1ShroudM4.funFact: Printstream uses a monochrome sci-fi print that stays readable in both bright and dark maps.

p1OverdriveGloves.description: Neon Vice gloves from m0NESY’s CS2 wardrobe — gloves that steal the killfeed spotlight.
p1OverdriveGloves.funFact: Sport Gloves changed how players match skins: full loadouts are often built around glove color first.

p1StarterUsp.description: Buster’s starter USP — not the flashiest gun, but every inventory legend begins with pistol rounds.
p1StarterUsp.funFact: Ticket to Hell is a community favorite for budget blue loadouts — cheap entry, big personality.

p1M4Howl.description: The receiver features a snarling wolf. Contraband quality.
p1M4Howl.funFact: The only Contraband skin in the game. Its art was stolen; Valve replaced the design, removed it from cases, and blocked Steam Market sales (trade only). It became a cult flex with absurd prices.

p1GraffitiFlyingAwper.description: Wall art of a winged sniper holding a scoped AWP.
p1GraffitiFlyingAwper.funFact: Commemorates coldzera’s MLG Columbus 2016 jump on Mirage B site: two no-scope kills on Liquid mid-air, then two more — a swing that flipped the match.

p1GraffitiDefuseInFire.description: Wall art of a CT burning alive while still defusing the bomb.
p1GraffitiDefuseInFire.funFact: Honors olofmeister at ESL One Cologne 2014: at 14–14 he held defuse through a Molotov on Overpass B and died the instant the bomb was defused for the win.

p1BizonJudgementAnubis.description: Egyptian motifs and Anubis-inspired art. Covert (red) quality.
p1BizonJudgementAnubis.funFact: The Bizon is infamous for weak armor penetration — and this is its only Covert skin. Chroma 3 openers groaned when a red AK or M4 roll turned into the «royal Bizon».

p1StickerDickstacy.description: Autograph sticker of pro player DickStacy from a Major.
p1StickerDickstacy.funFact: Valve rejected his signature art multiple times for being too explicit. He got approved with giant «DICK» text — bought in bulk for meme crafts.

p1StickerHowl.funFact: Like the M4A4 Howl, the sticker was hit by a copyright claim — art replaced, old version made Contraband, and its capsule removed from the game.

p1MusicEz4ence.description: Music kit track by Finnish band The Verkkars, dedicated to team ENCE.
p1MusicEz4ence.funFact: Started as a fan meme when ENCE shocked everyone at Katowice 2019. Valve added it officially — now it’s the classic MVP troll anthem.

p1InfernoBananaBarrels.funFact: Old Inferno banana had a yellow car and barrels. NiP’s Xizt kept dying to Molotovs or getting stuck there — fans called it «Xizt’s barrels». Remakes removed the car, but veterans remember.

p1OverpassOlofBoost.description: Invisible ledge texture under the player’s feet.
p1OverpassOlofBoost.funFact: DreamHack Winter 2014: Fnatic used a three-man boost so olofmeister stood on a pixel ledge with full AWP vision at 3–12 vs LDLC. Scandal, forfeit, patch — and the «no walking on air» sign joke on Overpass.

tarkovLoot.label: Project 2
tarkovLoot.title: Streamer Tarkov loot
tarkovLoot.subtitle: Streamer items for Escape from Tarkov — Collector-style loot with category filters. Tap a slot to mark it collected.

p2NutSackBalaclava.description: A knit headpiece that covers the head and face, leaving only the eyes exposed. Made of dense wool and great against the cold. Bears a "Nut Sack" label.
p2NutSackBalaclava.funFact: Dedicated to streamer TheBurntPeanut. In English slang, "nut sack" has a very cheeky meaning, so a balaclava with this name sparked endless jokes on stream.

p2DomontovichUshanka.description: A regular winter ushanka with a cockade. The owner's surname — Domontovich — is neatly embroidered on the inside.
p2DomontovichUshanka.funFact: Made for Andrey Domontovich, the Russian streamer behind Dyadya Dyoma, known for cozy streams and guides where he often wore this kind of hat.

p2GloriousEMask.description: A stylish protective half-mask that offers light ballistic protection for the face. "Glorious E" is stamped on the inside.
p2GloriousEMask.funFact: Glorious_E is known for hyper-aggressive gunplay and almost always running Tarkov with glasses and a half-mask. BSG copied his look straight into the game.

p2PestilyMask.description: An authentic leather plague doctor mask with a long beak. Looks ominous and smells of herbs and old leather.
p2PestilyMask.funFact: Dedicated to Pestily, the face of Tarkov worldwide. During charity marathons that raised hundreds of thousands for kids, he wore a real plague mask on stream when donation goals were hit.

p2ShroudHalfMask.description: A neoprene half-mask with the Shroud logo. Keeps dust, smoke, and unwanted stares out of your airways.
p2ShroudHalfMask.funFact: FPS legend Shroud jumped into Tarkov early. BSG was so happy they added this mask quickly — for a long time it was the flex of a rich, experienced player.

p2SmokeBalaclava.description: A black tactical balaclava made of fire-resistant material. A favorite piece for stealthy operators.
p2SmokeBalaclava.funFact: Tied to Smoke, a hardcore sim and DayZ veteran known for cinematic tactical play and a deep radio voice. The black mask fits his low-profile style.

p2JohnbGlasses.description: Sunglasses in a futuristic frame with mirrored lenses. "Liquid DNB" is printed on the temple.
p2JohnbGlasses.funFact: Dedicated to British DJ and streamer John B (Drum & Bass). He streamed Tarkov from his studio, always in neon futuristic shades.

p2ViibiinSneaker.description: A name-brand athletic shoe that has clearly seen a few fights. The Viibiin logo is visible on the sole.
p2ViibiinSneaker.funFact: Viibiin is hyperactive with wild movement and constant jumping. The in-game sneaker jokes that his PMC never stops sprinting.

p2DrdBodyArmor.description: A concealed-carry light vest customized with bright graffiti and a DRD logo. Protection is mediocre, style is not.
p2DrdBodyArmor.funFact: A nod to DrLupo (old tag DrD). You can actually wear it, but protection is deliberately weak — pure fashion flex.

p2FakeMustache.description: Fake adhesive mustache. Great for disguises or just ruining your squad's seriousness.
p2FakeMustache.funFact: A wink at Sequisha's legendary real mustache. Players pair it with glasses to cosplay "undercover agents" and troll teammates.

p2RavenFigurine.description: An elegant raven figurine cast in dark metal. Looks like a trophy from an old tournament win.
p2RavenFigurine.funFact: It mirrors a real trophy — added after Markstrom won the first official Tarkov Twitch Rivals streamer tournament.

p2AxelParrot.description: A hand-painted porcelain parrot figurine. "Axel" is neatly written on the stand.
p2AxelParrot.funFact: For Axel_TV, whose real pet parrot often shouted over the game and made hearing footsteps impossible.

p2LootLordPlushie.description: A small plush in a crown and robe, known locally as the "Loot Lord". Luck for loot goblins.
p2LootLordPlushie.funFact: Another DrLupo item — chat crowned him Loot Lord for absurd container RNG. The plush is basically channel merch.

p2BearBuddy.description: A plush bear in mini BEAR PMC camo. Tough but cute company for any fighter.
p2BearBuddy.funFact: For Mishka_Bear — the nickname became loot. Real merch sold out in minutes after fans fell in love with it.

p2BakeezyCookbook.description: A worn cookbook full of margin notes and improvised recipes. "BakeEzy" on the cover.
p2BakeezyCookbook.funFact: BakeEzy would discuss cooking with chat during slow raids. The book jokes that cuisine beats gunfights in Tarkov.

p2AntiqueBook.description: An old leather-bound tome. Yellowed pages and text in a long-forgotten language.
p2AntiqueBook.funFact: For lore nerd Kotton, one of Tarkov's earliest streamers. The text is a dev Easter egg thanking alpha testers.

p2SheefggPiggyBank.description: A ceramic piggy bank with the SheefGG logo. Coins rattle inside; surprisingly sturdy.
p2SheefggPiggyBank.funFact: SheefGG runs insane ruble challenges. In-game it's functional: 1 inventory slot, 4 inner slots for cash only.

p2YmxWater.description: A bottle of pristine artesian water branded YMXC. Quenches thirst in Tarkov's hot summers.
p2YmxWater.funFact: Dedicated to Chinese streamer YMXC — a nod to Asia's huge role in Tarkov's growth.

p2LupoCoffee.description: A tin of premium coffee beans from Dr. Lupo. The smell alone could revive a dead PMC.
p2LupoCoffee.funFact: DrLupo's third item — he loves good coffee. IRL his coffee brand donates to St. Jude Children's Hospital.

p2GigabeefMeat.description: High-calorie military stew. "GigaBeef" on the label — filling and reliable.
p2GigabeefMeat.funFact: For GigaBeef's deep-dive mechanics content. The stew can is a metaphor for dense, nutritious videos.

p2RatCola.description: Highly carbonated cola-flavored energy drink. Favorite of local "rats" camping exits.
p2RatCola.funFact: General Sam popularized rat play. The can shows a rat; RatCola is the unofficial anthem of campers.

p2EnglishTea42.description: A pack of elite English tea, "42 Signature Blend". Refined taste amid a ruined city.
p2EnglishTea42.funFact: For Sacriel — 42 is his favorite number (Hitchhiker's Guide). True Brit; tea on nearly every stream.

p2FrenchBaguette.description: A crispy French baguette from a local bakery. Somehow still fresh in the chaos.
p2FrenchBaguette.funFact: For French streamer Mika. Chat joked the baguet was the deadliest melee weapon thanks to its stiff, long model.

p2Fireklean.description: Premium synthetic gun oil for cleaning and lubrication. Smooth action even in hard frost.
p2Fireklean.funFact: The first streamer item in Tarkov history — for Klean. Real-world FireKlean even sued bloggers who said it was just cooking oil.

p2DeadlyslobBeardOil.description: Deadlyslob's tactical beard oil. Soft hair and a woody, rugged scent.
p2DeadlyslobBeardOil.funFact: For Canadian pioneer DeadlySlob. His beard is iconic — Nikita Buyanov personally signed off on the oil.

p2LvndmarkRatPoison.description: LVNDMARK-brand rodent poison. Highly toxic — handle with care.
p2LvndmarkRatPoison.funFact: LVNDMARK hates rat play. Devs trolled him with rat poison as his named item.

p2InseqWrench.description: A heavy professional pipe wrench painted bright red. "Inseq" stamped on the handle.
p2InseqWrench.funFact: Polish streamer Inseq — red wrench nods to Half-Life and Gordon Freeman's crowbar.

p2TigzresqSplint.description: Elastic Tigzresq splint for fractures. Quick to apply, holds the limb steady.
p2TigzresqSplint.funFact: Tigz breaks legs constantly with stunt jumps — the splint is gentle trolling of his playstyle.

p2OldFiresteel.description: Old reliable magnesium firesteel. Fire in any weather when matches are soaked.
p2OldFiresteel.funFact: For survivalist Eroktic, famous for yelling "Fire! Fire!" during early Tarkov firefights.

p2DundukFloppy.description: An old 3.5" floppy labeled "Dunduk" in marker. Secrets or an old game — who knows.
p2DundukFloppy.funFact: For Russian streamer Dunduk — a floppy in the SSD era jokes about his old-school tactics.

p2Golden1GPhone.description: Exclusive smartphone in solid gold. Dead electronics, excellent bullion.
p2Golden1GPhone.funFact: Summit1g's iconic phone-check during raids got his PMC killed constantly — hence the golden 1GPhone.

p2DesmondpilakCd.description: A CD in a cracked case. "DesmondPilak" scrawled on the disc.
p2DesmondpilakCd.funFact: DesmondPilak loves retro music and played old tracks on long raids — the CD is that vibe.

p2CyborgKillerVhs.description: Rare VHS of a late-80s action cult classic. Video-store era treasure.
p2CyborgKillerVhs.funFact: "Cyborg Killer" is a community meme for scarily accurate Scav bots that headshoted through bushes across the map.

p2WzWallet.description: Worn leather wallet embossed WZ. Hidden pockets for valuable bills or cards.
p2WzWallet.funFact: WillerZ parkour king — wallet nods to stashes in impossible spots via geometry bugs.

p2GingyKeychain.description: Handmade fabric key pouch with a Gingy print. Keeps small keys together.
p2GingyKeychain.funFact: One of the few useful streamer items — a real key container early wipe, not just a trinket.

p2MissamForkliftKey.description: Small key stamped with Missam's logo. Starts a diesel forklift — in theory.
p2MissamForkliftKey.funFact: Players hunted Factory for a drivable forklift quest for ages — it's just a collectible souvenir.

p2VeritasGuitarPick.description: Veritas-branded guitar pick, tough plastic, barely worn.
p2VeritasGuitarPick.funFact: Veritas is a pro musician and dev of the Battle Buddy Tarkov app.

p2BaddieRedBeard.description: Bright red fake beard. Belonged to some eccentric local survivor.
p2BaddieRedBeard.funFact: Baddie's real ginger beard — equippable in-game and visible from a kilometer away.

p2TamatthiKunai.description: Souvenir kunai replica. Soft metal, useless in combat, looks cool.
p2TamatthiKunai.funFact: Tamatthi loves anime — the kunai mocks useless mall-ninja loot in a military sim.

p2Kc130Model.description: Scale model of a Lockheed KC-130 transport. Detailed aviation souvenir.
p2Kc130Model.funFact: Onepeg patch/economy breakdowns — the KC-130 is the plane that drops airdrops in Tarkov.

p2SilverBadge.description: Old award token of fine silver with heraldic engraving on the face.
p2SilverBadge.funFact: DeadlySlob's second item — originally meant as a prize for internal streamer hardcore events.

p2AntiqueAxe.description: Old forged axe with carved handle. Blade still razor sharp.
p2AntiqueAxe.funFact: For Grimmmz — added during the "hatchet runners" era of naked melee loot sprints.

p2GoldenRooster.description: Porcelain rooster figurine gilded with gold leaf. Rich Tarkov citizens hid these in safes.
p2GoldenRooster.funFact: Became a Collector quest item — homage to the "rooster" meme for noisy newbie PMCs in RU chat.

p2GoldenEgg.description: Heavy gold jewelry piece studded with small gems. Any looter's dream.
p2GoldenEgg.funFact: BadJuJu's "steel balls" joke — what you need to solo Labs against cheaters and Raiders.

rustLoot.label: Project 3
rustLoot.title: Rust streamer drops & lore
rustLoot.subtitle: Twitch drops and streamer skins in Rust — armor, «legal» sights, and base gadgets. Tap a slot to mark it collected.

p3NinjaSuit.description: Full cloth ninja suit for hiding in the dark. Replaces your default clothing set.
p3NinjaSuit.funFact: Legendary Twitch Drop for BaboAbe: craft day-one for 60 cloth and 2 sewing kits, 25% bullet protection on the whole body, replaces jacket/pants/boots/gloves — and no legal equivalent if you missed it.

p3BigGrinMask.description: Heavy metal facemask painted with a huge toothy white grin.
p3BigGrinMask.funFact: Not a drop itself — a streamer-popularized flex skin. $500–800 on Steam; die to Big Grin and you’re probably fighting a 10k-hour demon.

p3Mp5OilRats.description: MP5 SMG in acid green with the Oil Rats logo.
p3Mp5OilRats.funFact: Approved «legal aimbot»: a cutout iron sight with full view vs the stock MP5 block — the $0 reflex streamers swear by.

p3AkTrainwreck.description: Assault Rifle (AK) wrapped in neon patterns and Trainwreckstv branding.
p3AkTrainwreck.funFact: A PVP favorite: the front sight glows at night so you keep crosshair awareness without lasers or flashlights giving you away.

p3HoboBarrel.description: Rusty barrel with a campfire inside — hobo romance vibes.
p3HoboBarrel.funFact: Stats like a 50-wood fire, but a tall flat hitbox makes it a pocket boost for jumping enemy walls and balconies without building stairs.

p3IndustrialDoor.description: Sheet metal door with a small rectangular window.
p3IndustrialDoor.funFact: Counter to door campers: peek the street through bulletproof glass without opening — no extra grates or window frames.

p3PokoPlush.description: Cute plush you can place on the floor or bed in your base.
p3PokoPlush.funFact: Hardcore Rust hated the Pokimane drop era — streamers raided bases and left plushies everywhere to troll «too cute» decorators.

dbdLoot.label: Project 4
dbdLoot.title: Dead by Daylight streamer loot
dbdLoot.subtitle: Charms and legendary streamer cosmetics in the Fog — tap a slot to mark it collected.

p4WarriorPuppers.description: A memorial charm of a loyal warrior pup with a purple shield, glowing in the Fog.
p4WarriorPuppers.howToGet: Redeem the permanent code WARRIORPUPPERS in the in-game store.
p4WarriorPuppers.funFact: A tribute to Max "Puppers", who helped grow DBD on Twitch from day one. He fought ALS and passed in 2023 — Behaviour added his dog so his legacy stays in the Fog.

p4VicViper.description: A miniature of the classic arcade starfighter.
p4VicViper.howToGet: Easter egg: select Cheryl Mason or The Executioner, return to the main menu, enter the Konami Code (↑↑↓↓←→←→ + A/B/Start or X/O/Options).
p4VicViper.funFact: Speedrun and retro streamers love showing this off — a nod to Konami marathons (Gradius × Silent Hill).

p4PandaTvShirt.description: Simple grey cotton tee with a bold gold PandaTV logo.
p4PandaTvShirt.howToGet: Originally for official PandaTV (China) streamers only — now one of the rarest cosmetics.
p4PandaTvShirt.funFact: After PandaTV shut down, these shirts became digital fossils — a badge for 2016–2017 era players.

p4H2oDeliriousJacket.description: Mask of Delirium — a warped Trapper face mask made for H2O Delirious.
p4H2oDeliriousJacket.howToGet: Rare Steam DLC codes that H2O Delirious could give to viewers (2016 streamer exclusive).
p4H2oDeliriousJacket.funFact: Along with Ohmwrecker’s Wraith skin and Bryce’s Meg jacket, this was part of Behaviour’s early YouTuber thank-you pack — artifact-rarity cosmetics from the pre-store era.

p4TwitchClaudette.description: Official purple Twitch hoodie with a white logo (Claudette).
p4TwitchClaudette.howToGet: TwitchCon 2016 attendees and Behaviour partner streamers only.
p4TwitchClaudette.funFact: Community meme: purple-hoodie Claudette will loop pallets, blind you, and teabag — peak «toxic» survivor energy.

fortniteLoot.label: Project 5
fortniteLoot.title: Fortnite streamer loot
fortniteLoot.subtitle: Icon Series creator outfits and viral stream-era cosmetics — tap a slot to mark it collected.

p5Ninja.description: Icon Series Tyler "Ninja" Blevins outfit — headband, high-tops, and peak-Fortnite stream energy.
p5Ninja.howToGet: Item Shop — Ninja set (Icon Series). Today only when Epic rotates it back, not Battle Pass.
p5Ninja.funFact: The skin landed when Ninja was pushing Fortnite to the top of Twitch. A lobby inspect in a 2019–2020 clip is instant nostalgia.

p5Bugha.description: Icon Series Kyle "Bugha" Giersdorf — 2019 World Cup champion look and competitive streamer badge.
p5Bugha.howToGet: Item Shop — Bugha set (Icon Series) tied to his World Cup win.
p5Bugha.funFact: After MSG finals, this outfit became the competitive Fortnite flex on streams — not whale money, just aim credentials.

p5Loserfruit.description: Icon Series Kathleen "Loserfruit" Belsten — bright Aussie streamer style and playful on-brand colors.
p5Loserfruit.howToGet: Item Shop — Loserfruit (Icon Series) creator collaboration.
p5Loserfruit.funFact: Her long Twitch run tracks Fortnite's creator boom — the Icon outfit still shows up in AU streamer montages and charity events.

p5TheGrefg.description: Icon Series TheGrefg — Spanish mega-streamer outfit built for maximum hype and fire motifs.
p5TheGrefg.howToGet: Item Shop — TheGrefg (Icon Series), unveiled during his record-breaking reveal stream.
p5TheGrefg.funFact: His cosmetic reveal stream smashed concurrent viewer records — a landmark Epic × streamer collab moment.

p5RenegadeRaider.description: OG Season 1 shop skin — early "renegade" look that became status currency in first-wave Fortnite streams.
p5RenegadeRaider.howToGet: Season 1 Item Shop (2017) — long retired; only legacy accounts.
p5RenegadeRaider.funFact: Raider in a 2018 stream lobby triggers instant "account age?" chat — genuine digital vintage.

p5BoogieDown.description: Classic emote rewarded for enabling two-factor authentication on your Epic account.
p5BoogieDown.howToGet: Free: enable 2FA in Epic account settings and claim the Fortnite reward.
p5BoogieDown.funFact: Streamers turned Boogie Down into "security goes hard" — a rare free emote everyone recognizes in clips.

p5OrangeJustice.description: Viral dance emote from the clip era and endless "Justice" chat spam on Twitch.
p5OrangeJustice.howToGet: Item Shop — Orange Justice (uncommon emote) on rotation.
p5OrangeJustice.funFact: Orange Justice after a stream snipe was 2018 clip gold — still ironic BM in creator lobbies today.

inventory.title: Cyber inventory
inventory.subtitle: Interactive streamer item slots — rarity glow, tilt, glitch on vault items. Tap a slot to mark it collected.
inventory.hint: Neon live dot = streamer online. Legendary and secret items glitch on hover.
